summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the readiness of a service for release and subsequent optimization efforts. Initial concerns included segment calculation issues for new frames lacking saved segments, which was addressed with a fix.

Regarding deployment, there were discussions about load times and data retrieval delays (up to 30-40 seconds). The team decided that if the data returned faster than 60 seconds, it would display correctly. A key decision was made to deploy the service and switch staging environments to compare versions.

Separately, another participant optimized a cycle within the ML API, suggesting deployment to staging for review.
decisions: The service is ready for release after addressing data loading issues.
Staging environment will be switched to use the new service version for comparison.
action_items: Deploy and test the optimized ML API cycle on staging.
